faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, always. Registration, profile creation, engineering tools, job applications, and community access are completely free for workers.
faq.a2: No. PipingBox provides preparation courses and practice exams to help you pass the official exam at an accredited testing center.
faq.q3: What certifications can I prepare for?
faq.a3: VCA (Belgium/Netherlands), SCC (Germany), and PRL (Spain). Our study materials cover all 22 modules of the official curriculum.
faq.q4: How much does the VCA course cost?
faq.a4: The VCA preparation course costs €59.90 EUR. This includes all study materials, practice quizzes, mock exams, and a certificate of completion.
faq.q5: Do the tools work without registration?
faq.a5: Yes, all engineering tools (wall thickness calculator, unit converter, pipe dimensions, etc.) are publicly accessible without creating an account.
